plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any bid above your value, you risk winning and losing money (paying more than the item is worth to you). For any bid below your value, you risk losing the item to someone who values it more, but you could have won it for a profit. Since this is round 1 with no prior history, I will strictly adhere to the dominant strategy. My value is $14, so I will bid $14.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you win if and only if your bid is the highest, and you pay the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values it more, while bidding more than your value risks winning but paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value of $34.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win if and only if your value exceeds the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values the item more than you do, while bidding more than your value risks paying more than the item is worth to you. My value is $33, so I will bid $33.
